comment: Allowed median growth per benchmark name pattern, over the default --threshold (first match wins). Measured on the bench agent over the five v0.4.0 baseline runs: the multi-threaded physics steps of 100 bodies vary up to 40 % (waking the workers), the physics world creation of 100 bodies up to 90 %, the MCP loopback round trips and the game-over scene load about 25 to 33 %; the flat path queries of 1024² maps switch between two modes about 15 % apart (296 µs or 340 µs on the streets map); the prefab instantiations into a 10000-entity scene are bimodal (nightly 2026-10-21 on the bench agent: 148 µs, 168 µs measured alone, baseline 125 µs; locally x2 outliers one run in three on both v0.4.0 and v0.5.0 code).
